description: Verified exam notes for 31 October 2026 covering NavIC, AI data governance, rural infrastructure, cotton policy, maritime security, EV testing, policing, defence leadership and Tamil Nadu science outreach.

stories.title: NVS-03 completes its first orbit-raising manoeuvre
stories.summary: ISRO reported that NVS-03, launched aboard GSLV-F18 late on 30 October, completed its first planned orbit-raising manoeuvre on 31 October 2026. The spacecraft is healthy, and further manoeuvres are planned before placement in its intended geosynchronous orbital slot; it should therefore not yet be described as operational.
key_facts: GSLV-F18 injected NVS-03 into a 170.3 km × 38,080 km orbit at 23:51 on 30 October 2026.
The first liquid-apogee-motor burn lasted 2,174.8 seconds and produced an estimated 5,477.6 km × 37,833.4 km orbit.
NVS-03 is the third satellite in the next-generation navigation series supporting continuity of IRNSS/NavIC services.
It carries an indigenous atomic clock and adds an L1 signal alongside L5 and S-band signals.
ISRO plans to place it in geosynchronous orbit at 111.75° East.
stories.exam_link: Revise NavIC/IRNSS, geosynchronous transfer and geosynchronous orbits, atomic clocks, satellite-navigation signals and the role of orbit-raising manoeuvres.
stories.source_title: Orbit manoeuvring of NVS-03 spacecraft — ISRO, 31 October 2026

stories.title: MeitY launches DEPA for AI Training handbook
stories.summary: The Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology launched a handbook for applying the Data Empowerment and Protection Architecture to AI training. The document presents a techno-legal framework for controlled, purpose-bound data collaboration; it is a framework for trusted access, not a transfer of unrestricted ownership over participating institutions' data.
key_facts: The handbook was unveiled in Bengaluru with support from the iSPIRT Foundation.
The framework combines contractual permissions, controlled computing environments and privacy-enhancing safeguards.
Data provenance is intended to trace the origin, permission and use of data throughout model training.
The stated design principle is that the model travels to the data rather than the data moving to the model.
stories.exam_link: Connect DEPA with consent-based data sharing, privacy, data fiduciaries, purpose limitation, provenance, confidential computing and responsible-AI governance.
stories.source_title: MeitY Launches DEPA for AI Training Handbook — PIB, 31 October 2026

stories.title: MoPR and CESL sign pact for EV facilities on Panchayat land
stories.summary: The Ministry of Panchayati Raj and Convergence Energy Services Limited signed an MoU to establish EV charging and battery-swapping stations at suitable Panchayat sites. The agreement creates an implementation framework and possible own-source revenue for rural local bodies; it does not mean that stations have already been installed nationwide.
key_facts: CESL is a wholly owned subsidiary of Energy Efficiency Services Limited under the Ministry of Power.
The proposed network may serve two-wheelers, three-wheelers, cars and medium and heavy-duty vehicles.
The Ministry will coordinate with State Panchayati Raj Departments to identify and monitor sites.
CESL will handle assessment, demand aggregation, supply, installation, testing, commissioning, operation and maintenance.
The arrangement seeks to create recurring own-source revenue for Gram, Block and District Panchayats.
stories.exam_link: Revise Part IX of the Constitution, the three tiers of Panchayati Raj, Gram Panchayat Development Plans, own-source revenue and rural clean-mobility infrastructure.
stories.source_title: People's Plan Campaign workshop and MoPR–CESL MoU — PIB, 31 October 2026

stories.title: Cotton import customs-duty exemption extended to 31 December
stories.summary: The Union Government extended the existing customs-duty exemption on cotton imports from 31 October to 31 December 2026. The notified two-month extension is intended to improve raw-material availability for textile and apparel producers, including specialised cotton needs, while easing input-cost pressure across the value chain.
key_facts: The Department of Revenue issued Notification No. 35/2026-Customs on 30 October 2026.
The exemption now remains available through 31 December 2026.
The stated objectives include supporting domestic manufacturing, MSMEs and textile competitiveness.
A customs-duty exemption changes the tax treatment of imports; it is not an import ban or quantitative quota.
stories.exam_link: Revise customs duties, tariff and non-tariff measures, textile value chains, MSMEs, raw-material inflation and the roles of the Departments of Revenue and Commerce.
stories.source_title: Customs Duty Exemption on Cotton Imports Extended — PIB, 31 October 2026

stories.title: Seven members join inaugural BIMSTEC maritime-security exercise
stories.summary: The inaugural BIMSTEC Maritime Security Exercise is being conducted from 30 October to 3 November 2026. It brings all seven members together to improve interoperability, maritime-domain awareness and coordination in the Bay of Bengal, translating regional commitments into a practical security exercise.
key_facts: BIMSTEC members are Bangladesh, Bhutan, India, Myanmar, Nepal, Sri Lanka and Thailand.
The exercise follows the sixth BIMSTEC Summit theme, Prosperous, Resilient and Open.
The Bay of Bengal links South Asia and Southeast Asia and supports trade, connectivity and energy security.
The Andaman and Nicobar Command is India's first integrated tri-service command.
stories.exam_link: Revise BIMSTEC, Bay of Bengal geography, maritime-domain awareness, sea lanes of communication, HADR and India's integrated theatre-command structure.
stories.source_title: Inaugural BIMSTEC Maritime Security Exercise — PIB, 31 October 2026

stories.title: PMGSY-IV approves 45 new rural-road works for Mizoram
stories.summary: The Rural Development Ministry approved Batch 1 of Mizoram's PMGSY-IV road works for FY 2026–27. The approval covers 45 roads measuring 509.54 km at an estimated cost of ₹710.40 crore and is intended to provide first-time all-weather road connectivity to 48 habitations; construction and completion remain future stages.
key_facts: The approved package comprises 45 road works with a combined length of 509.54 km.
The estimated cost is ₹710.40 crore.
The works are expected to connect 48 habitations to all-weather roads for the first time.
Existing PMGSY sanctions for Mizoram cover 367 roads measuring 4,935 km and seven bridges at a cost of ₹3,412 crore.
stories.exam_link: Revise PMGSY, all-weather rural connectivity, habitation-based eligibility, the North-East's transport constraints and the difference between project approval and completion.
stories.source_title: Mizoram Road Works Approved under PMGSY-IV — PIB, 31 October 2026

stories.title: WDC-PMKSY review highlights ridge-to-valley watershed works
stories.summary: The Department of Land Resources reviewed WDC-PMKSY 2.0 works in Varude, Gulani and Wafgaon villages of Khed, Pune district. The field review examined structures for reducing runoff, improving groundwater recharge and supporting agriculture; villagers reported improved water availability and two to three crop cycles across the wider 11-village project area.
key_facts: WDC-PMKSY focuses on soil and water conservation, agricultural productivity and sustainable rural development.
Reviewed structures included continuous contour trenches, earthen and cement nala bunds, Kolhapuri-type weirs and ponds.
The ridge-to-valley approach treats upper catchments before drainage-line and downstream works.
The review also covered farm ponds, horticulture, agricultural equipment and support to women's self-help groups.
stories.exam_link: Revise PMKSY components, watershed and catchment concepts, groundwater recharge, contour trenches, check dams and community maintenance of water-harvesting assets.
stories.source_title: Review of WDC-PMKSY 2.0 Works in Khed, Pune — PIB, 31 October 2026

stories.title: ARAI opens advanced battery and EV powertrain test facilities
stories.summary: The Union Heavy Industries Minister virtually inaugurated an Advanced Battery Laboratory and a two-dynamometer e-axle and EV powertrain test facility at ARAI during its diamond-jubilee programme in Pune. These are completed testing facilities intended to expand domestic validation, safety assessment, certification and export-compliance capability.
key_facts: The battery laboratory was developed with an investment of about ₹55 crore.
It was established under Phase II of the Enhancement of Competitiveness in the Indian Capital Goods Sector scheme.
Its work covers battery testing, validation, safety assessment and performance evaluation for electric and hybrid vehicles.
The twin-dynamometer facility supports design, development and optimisation of e-axles and electric powertrains.
ARAI also announced an MoU-linked plan for an advanced crash-test facility; that separate facility is not yet complete.
stories.exam_link: Revise ARAI, vehicle homologation, Bharat NCAP, battery safety, e-axles, dynamometers and the distinction between R&D testing and commercial manufacturing.
stories.source_title: ARAI Diamond Jubilee Mobility Initiatives — PIB, 31 October 2026

stories.title: Dakshata Padak awarded to 490 police and security personnel
stories.summary: The Ministry of Home Affairs announced the 2026 Kendriya Grihmantri Dakshata Padak for 490 personnel from States, Union Territories, central armed police forces and central police organisations. The medal recognises excellence across operations, investigation, intelligence and forensic science.
key_facts: The medal was instituted through a Ministry of Home Affairs notification dated 1 February 2024.
Eligible organisations include police forces, intelligence branches, CAPFs, CPOs, the National Security Guard, Assam Rifles and forensic-science establishments.
The medal is announced each 31 October, the birth anniversary of Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel.
The award recognises professional excellence and is not a gallantry decoration limited to combat.
stories.exam_link: Revise the Union and State police framework, CAPFs, CPOs, forensic science, intelligence organisations and the significance of National Unity Day on 31 October.
stories.source_title: Kendriya Grihmantri Dakshata Padak 2026 — PIB, 31 October 2026

stories.title: Air Chief Marshal Ashutosh Dixit becomes 29th Air Chief
stories.summary: Air Chief Marshal Ashutosh Dixit assumed charge as the 29th Chief of the Air Staff on 31 October 2026, succeeding Air Chief Marshal A. P. Singh. The appointment places a serving four-star officer at the professional head of the Indian Air Force; the Chief of the Air Staff is distinct from the civilian Ministry of Defence leadership.
key_facts: He was commissioned into the fighter stream on 6 December 1986.
He is a fighter pilot, qualified flying instructor and experimental test pilot with more than 3,500 flying hours.
His modernisation work included Jaguar and MiG-27 upgrades and LCA Mk-I Tejas IOC and FOC activities.
He previously served as Vice Chief of the Air Staff and as Chief of Integrated Defence Staff to the Chairman, Chiefs of Staff Committee.
stories.exam_link: Revise the Chiefs of Staff Committee, Chief of Defence Staff, Integrated Defence Staff, service chiefs, military ranks and the Tejas programme's IOC/FOC stages.
stories.source_title: Air Chief Marshal Ashutosh Dixit Assumes Charge as Chief of the Air Staff — PIB, 31 October 2026

stories.title: CSIR-SERC takes Jigyasa programme to Kolli Hills tribal schools
stories.summary: CSIR's Structural Engineering Research Centre in Chennai conducted a two-day Jigyasa student–scientist workshop at four schools in the Kolli Hills of Namakkal district. Around 250 students and 20 teachers participated, extending direct science outreach to tribal-school communities in Tamil Nadu.
key_facts: The workshops were held on 29 and 30 October 2026 at four schools in Kolli Hills taluk.
Participating locations included Valavanthinadu, Sengarai, Thindupatty and Thembalam.
Jigyasa is CSIR's national Student–Scientist Connect programme.
CSIR-SERC is a constituent laboratory of the Council of Scientific and Industrial Research and is based in Chennai.
stories.exam_link: Revise CSIR's institutional role, the location and geography of Kolli Hills and Namakkal district, tribal education and science-popularisation programmes.
stories.source_title: CSIR-SERC Jigyasa Workshop in Namakkal District — PIB Chennai, 31 October 2026

mcqs.question: NVS-03 is intended to strengthen continuity of which Indian satellite-navigation system?
mcqs.explanation: NVS-03 belongs to the next-generation navigation series supporting continuity of IRNSS, operationally known as NavIC.

mcqs.question: Which additional navigation signal is carried by NVS-03 alongside L5 and S-band signals?
mcqs.explanation: ISRO states that NVS-03 adds an L1 signal while retaining L5 and S-band navigation signals.

mcqs.question: In the DEPA for AI Training framework, what is intended to travel to the data?
mcqs.explanation: The framework's controlled-computing approach is described as taking the model to the data rather than moving data to the model.

mcqs.question: CESL, which signed the Panchayat EV-infrastructure MoU, is wholly owned by which entity?
mcqs.explanation: Convergence Energy Services Limited is a wholly owned subsidiary of Energy Efficiency Services Limited.

mcqs.question: The cotton-import customs-duty exemption has been extended up to which date?
mcqs.explanation: Notification No. 35/2026-Customs extends the existing exemption through 31 December 2026.

mcqs.question: Which one is not a member of BIMSTEC?
mcqs.explanation: BIMSTEC has seven members; Maldives is not among them.

mcqs.question: India's first integrated tri-service command is located in which island group?
mcqs.explanation: The Andaman and Nicobar Command, headquartered in the island group, is India's first integrated tri-service command.

mcqs.question: How many Mizoram habitations are expected to receive first-time all-weather connectivity under the newly approved PMGSY-IV package?
mcqs.explanation: The 45 approved road works are intended to connect 48 habitations for the first time.

mcqs.question: Which approach was used for the watershed structures reviewed under WDC-PMKSY 2.0 in Khed?
mcqs.explanation: The reviewed structures follow the ridge-to-valley approach used in integrated watershed treatment.

mcqs.question: Approximately how much was invested in ARAI's Advanced Battery Laboratory?
mcqs.explanation: The laboratory was developed with a total investment of approximately ₹55 crore.

mcqs.question: The Kendriya Grihmantri Dakshata Padak recognises excellence in which set of fields?
options: Operations, investigation, intelligence and forensic science
mcqs.explanation: The Home Ministry medal covers operational, investigative, intelligence and forensic-science excellence.

mcqs.question: The Dakshata Padak is announced annually on the birth anniversary of whom?
mcqs.explanation: The award is announced on 31 October, Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel's birth anniversary.

mcqs.question: Air Chief Marshal Ashutosh Dixit became which numbered Chief of the Air Staff?
mcqs.explanation: He assumed charge as the 29th Chief of the Air Staff on 31 October 2026.

mcqs.question: Kolli Hills, where CSIR-SERC held its Jigyasa workshop, lies in which Tamil Nadu district?
mcqs.explanation: The workshop was held at four schools in the Kolli Hills region of Namakkal district.

mcqs.question: What is the primary purpose of CSIR's Jigyasa initiative?
mcqs.explanation: Jigyasa is CSIR's Student–Scientist Connect programme for promoting scientific awareness among school students.
